const FACE_SETS={

let currentFaces=FACE_SETS.classic;
function resolveWorldId(){if(state.worldMode&&state.worldMode!=='auto')return state.worldMode;const order=['egypt','japan'];return order[Math.floor((Math.max(1,state.level)-1)/5)%order.length]}
function activeAmbientTrack(){return state.ambienceMode!=='auto'?state.ambienceMode:(WORLDS[resolveWorldId()]||WORLDS.egypt).ambient}
let worldBannerTimer=0;
function showWorldBanner(meta){if(!$('worldBanner'))return;$('worldBannerTitle').textContent=meta.name.toUpperCase();$('worldBannerText').textContent=meta.subtitle;const n=$('worldBanner');n.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(worldBannerTimer);worldBannerTimer=setTimeout(()=>n.classList.remove('show'),2200)}
function applyWorldTheme(showIntro=false){const id=resolveWorldId(),meta=WORLDS[id]||WORLDS.egypt;const changed=state.activeWorld!==id;state.activeWorld=id;currentFaces=FACE_SETS[id]||FACE_SETS.classic;document.body.setAttribute('data-world',id);const variants=WORLD_BACKGROUND_VARIANTS[id]||[];const pickNewBackground=()=>{if(!variants.length)return '';if(variants.length===1)return variants[0];return variants[Math.floor(Math.random()*variants.length)]};if(changed||showIntro||!state.activeWorldBackground||!(variants||[]).includes(state.activeWorldBackground)){state.activeWorldBackground=pickNewBackground()}app.style.setProperty('--world-bg-image',`url("${state.activeWorldBackground}")`);if($('worldChip'))$('worldChip').textContent=meta.name;if($('worldPreview'))$('worldPreview').innerHTML=`<strong>${meta.name.toUpperCase()}</strong><span>${meta.subtitle.toUpperCase()}</span>`;if(state.ambienceMode==='auto'&&state.music&&!$('game').classList.contains('hidden')&&!state.paused){stopMusic();startMusic();}if(showIntro||changed)showWorldBanner(meta)}
function tileHtml(t){if(t.hidden&&!t.revealed)return '<div class="tile-side"></div><div class="tile-face"><div class="mystery-mark">?</div></div>';return `<div class="tile-side"></div><div class="tile-face"><div class="symbol">${currentFaces[t.type]}</div></div>`}
function updateUI(){let remaining=state.tiles.filter(t=>!t.removed).length+state.tray.length;$('levelNum').textContent=state.mode==='daily'?'DAILY':state.mode==='zen'?'ZEN':state.mode==='mystery'?'MYSTERY':state.level;$('scoreNum').textContent=state.score.toLocaleString('en-US');$('remainingNum').textContent=remaining;$('progressFill').style.width=((state.initialCount-remaining)/Math.max(1,state.initialCount)*100)+'%';$('shuffleCount').textContent=state.shuffles;$('hintCount').textContent=state.hints;$('magicCount').textContent=state.magic;$('shuffle').disabled=state.shuffles<=0;$('hint').disabled=state.hints<=0;$('undo').disabled=!state.history.length;$('magic').disabled=state.magic<=0;if($('worldChip'))$('worldChip').textContent=(WORLDS[state.activeWorld]||WORLDS.egypt).name}
function drawTray(){trayEl.innerHTML='';for(let i=0;i<4;i++){let slot=document.createElement('div');slot.className='tray-slot'+(state.tray[i]?'':' empty');slot.dataset.slot=i;let t=state.tiles.find(x=>x.id===state.tray[i]);if(t){let node=document.createElement('button');node.className='tray-tile tile'+(state.theme==='jade'?' zen-tiles':'');node.title='Return this tile to board';node.dataset.trayId=t.id;node.setAttribute('aria-label',`Return stored tile ${i+1} to board`);node.innerHTML=tileHtml(t);node.onclick=()=>returnStored(t.id);slot.appendChild(node)}trayEl.appendChild(slot)}}
function drawBoard(){
  let all=state.tiles,visible=all.filter(t=>!t.removed);board.textContent='';
  if(!visible.length){updateUI();return}
  let W=board.clientWidth,H=board.clientHeight;
  if(W<50||H<50){requestAnimationFrame(drawBoard);return}
  let maxX=Math.max(...all.map(t=>t.x)),maxY=Math.max(...all.map(t=>t.y)),ratio=1.25;
  let w=Math.max(9,Math.min((W-12)/(maxX+1.22),(H-16)/((maxY+1.16)*ratio)));
  let h=w*ratio,left=(W-(maxX+1)*w)/2,top=(H-(maxY+1)*h)/2;
  let frag=document.createDocumentFragment();visible.sort((a,b)=>a.z-b.z||a.y-b.y||a.x-b.x);
  for(let t of visible){
    const available=free(t,all);let n=document.createElement('button');n.type='button';
    n.className='tile'+(available?'':' blocked')+(t.hidden&&!t.revealed?' mystery-tile':'')+(state.theme==='jade'?' zen-tiles':'');
    n.style.cssText=`--w:${w}px;--h:${h}px;--z:${100+t.z*100+t.y};left:${left+t.x*w-t.z*w*.16}px;top:${top+t.y*h-t.z*h*.14}px`;
    n.dataset.id=t.id;
    n.setAttribute('aria-label',t.hidden&&!t.revealed?`Face-down tile ${available?'tap to reveal':'blocked'}`:`Tile ${t.type+1} ${available?'available':'blocked'}`);
    n.innerHTML=tileHtml(t);frag.appendChild(n)
  }
  board.appendChild(frag);updateUI();

function render(){drawTray();drawBoard();updateUI()}
function saveActive(){save()}
function alertToast(msg){let n=$('toast');n.textContent=msg;n.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>n.classList.remove('show'),1600)}
function modal(id){allModals.forEach(n=>$(n).classList.toggle('hidden',n!==id));state.paused=!!id;if(id==='settingsModal')updateSettings();if(state.paused)stopMusic();else if(state.music)startMusic()}
function closeModal(){allModals.forEach(n=>$(n).classList.add('hidden'));state.paused=false;if(state.music&&!$('game').classList.contains('hidden'))startMusic()}
function showGame(){ $('home').classList.add('hidden');$('game').classList.remove('hidden') }
function home(){state.epoch++;stopMusic();closeModal();$('game').classList.add('hidden');$('home').classList.remove('hidden');$('play').innerHTML=`▶ &nbsp; PLAY LEVEL ${state.level}`;applyWorldTheme(false);save()}
function newGame(mode='classic',restore=false){state.epoch++;state.mode=mode;state.seed=mode==='daily'?dateSeed():mode==='zen'?108399:mode==='mystery'?state.level*76129+93811:state.level*84719+417;state.tray=[];state.history=[];state.hints=mode==='zen'?99:5;state.shuffles=mode==='zen'?99:3;state.magic=mode==='zen'?99:2;state.combo=0;state.lastMatch=0;state.busy=false;try{state.tiles=generate(mode==='daily'?((dateSeed()%5)+1):mode==='zen'?2:state.level,state.seed);applyMystery(state.tiles,state.seed,mode,state.level)}catch(e){console.error(e);alertToast('Could not build this board');return}
const active=saved.active;if(restore&&mode==='classic'&&active&&active.level===state.level&&active.tiles&&active.tiles.length===state.tiles.length){state.tiles=active.tiles;state.tray=active.tray||[];state.score=active.score||state.score;state.hints=active.hints??5;state.shuffles=active.shuffles??3;state.magic=active.magic??2}
state.mysteryCount=state.tiles.filter(t=>t.hidden&&!t.revealed).length;state.initialCount=state.tiles.length;state.gameStarted=Date.now();showGame();closeModal();applyWorldTheme(true);render();save();if(state.music)startMusic();}
function remember(){state.history.push(snapshot());if(state.history.length>60)state.history.shift()}
function vibrate(pattern){if(state.vibrate&&navigator.vibrate)try{navigator.vibrate(pattern)}catch{}}
function center(rect){return{x:rect.left+rect.width/2,y:rect.top+rect.height/2}}
function animatedFlight(node,i){const dst=trayEl.children[i];if(!node||!dst)return;const from=node.getBoundingClientRect(),to=dst.getBoundingClientRect();let ghost=node.cloneNode(true);ghost.classList.remove('blocked','hinted');ghost.classList.add('fly-tile');ghost.style.left=from.left+'px';ghost.style.top=from.top+'px';ghost.style.width=from.width+'px';ghost.style.height=from.height+'px';ghost.style.setProperty('--w',from.width+'px');ghost.style.setProperty('--h',from.height+'px');app.appendChild(ghost);ghost.style.position='fixed';void ghost.offsetWidth;const dx=(to.left+to.width/2)-(from.left+from.width/2),dy=(to.top+to.height/2)-(from.top+from.height/2);ghost.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) scale(${Math.min(to.width/from.width,to.height/from.height)*.83}) rotate(-5deg)`;ghost.style.opacity='.85';setTimeout(()=>ghost.remove(),470);ring(from.left+from.width/2,from.top+from.height/2,'#fff2b1',from.width*.6)}
// Game state changes synchronously. Flights, bursts and combo graphics never hold a global input lock.
function collect(id){
  if(state.paused||state.busy)return false;
  const t=state.tiles.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!t||!free(t,state.tiles)){sfx('error');return false}
  if(t.hidden&&!t.revealed)return revealHidden(t);
  const partnerId=state.tray.find(stored=>state.tiles.find(x=>x.id===stored)?.type===t.type);
  if(state.tray.length>=4&&!partnerId){sfx('error');modal('fullModal');return false}
  const node=board.querySelector(`[data-id="${id}"]`);
  const slotIndex=partnerId?state.tray.indexOf(partnerId):state.tray.length;
  const destination=trayEl.children[slotIndex];
  const targetRect=destination?.getBoundingClientRect();
  remember();
  t.removed=true;
  const epoch=state.epoch;
  animatedFlight(node,slotIndex);
  sfx('collect');vibrate(8);
  if(partnerId){
    // Free the slot and update score immediately, even if another finger taps right now.
    state.tray=state.tray.filter(stored=>stored!==partnerId);
    let now=Date.now();state.combo=now-state.lastMatch<4200?state.combo+1:1;
    state.lastMatch=now;
    const points=160+Math.max(0,state.combo-1)*95;
    state.score+=points;
    const combo=state.combo;
    const fxPoint=targetRect?center(targetRect):center(trayEl.getBoundingClientRect());
    const oldPiece=destination?.querySelector('.tray-tile');
    if(oldPiece){const ghost=oldPiece.cloneNode(true);ghost.classList.add('arrival-echo');
      ghost.style.cssText=`position:fixed;left:${targetRect.left+2}px;top:${targetRect.top+2}px;width:${targetRect.width-4}px;height:${targetRect.height-4}px;--w:${targetRect.width-4}px;--h:${targetRect.height-4}px;pointer-events:none;z-index:4000;`;
      document.body.appendChild(ghost);setTimeout(()=>ghost.remove(),310)}
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(epoch!==state.epoch)return;
      burst(fxPoint.x,fxPoint.y,40,6);ring(fxPoint.x,fxPoint.y,'#ffe7ac',56);
      sfx(combo>=3?'combo':'match');vibrate(combo>=3?[18,20,25]:[12,15,17]);comboText(combo,points);
      if(combo>=3){$('flash').classList.remove('flashing');void $('flash').offsetWidth;$('flash').classList.add('flashing')}
    },260);
  }else{
    state.tray.push(id);
  }
  // Both board and collection now reflect the move, without waiting for animations.
  drawTray();drawBoard();save();
  const anyBoard=state.tiles.some(x=>!x.removed);
  if(!anyBoard&&!state.tray.length){
    setTimeout(()=>{if(epoch===state.epoch&&!state.paused&&!state.busy&&state.tray.length===0&&!state.tiles.some(x=>!x.removed))won()},570);
  }else if(anyBoard&&state.tray.length===0&&!findPair()){
    setTimeout(()=>{if(epoch===state.epoch&&!state.paused&&state.tray.length===0&&!findPair())modal('stuckModal')},730);
  }
  return true;
}
function revealHidden(t){
  if(state.paused||!free(t,state.tiles)||!t.hidden||t.revealed)return false;
  remember();t.revealed=true;state.mysteryCount=Math.max(0,state.mysteryCount-1);
  drawBoard();let el=board.querySelector(`[data-id="${t.id}"]`);el?.classList.add('flip-reveal');
  sfx('hint');vibrate(8);save();return true;
}

function returnStored(id){if(state.paused||state.busy)return;let t=state.tiles.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!t)return;remember();t.removed=false;state.tray=state.tray.filter(x=>x!==id);sfx('return');vibrate(8);closeModal();render();save()}
function findPair(){let available=state.tiles.filter(x=>free(x,state.tiles)),chosen=new Map();for(let x of state.tray){let t=state.tiles.find(y=>y.id===x);let other=available.find(a=>a.type===t.type);if(other)return[t,other]}for(let a of available){if(chosen.has(a.type))return[chosen.get(a.type),a];chosen.set(a.type,a)}return null}
function hint(){if(state.paused||state.busy||state.hints<=0)return;let pair=findPair();if(!pair){alertToast('No available matches — try Shuffle');sfx('error');return}state.hints--;pair.forEach(t=>{if(t.hidden&&!t.revealed)t.revealed=true});drawBoard();pair.forEach(t=>{let tile=board.querySelector(`[data-id="${t.id}"]`)||trayEl.querySelector(`[data-tray-id="${t.id}"]`);tile?.classList.add('hinted')});sfx('hint');updateUI();save()}
function reshuffle(){if(state.busy||state.shuffles<=0)return;remember();state.shuffles--;let alive=state.tiles.filter(t=>!t.removed);let rand=rng((Date.now()^state.seed)>>>0),types=alive.map(x=>x.type);for(let tries=0;tries<250;tries++){shuffle(types,rand);alive.forEach((t,i)=>t.type=types[i]);if(findPair())break}if(!findPair()){let avail=alive.filter(x=>free(x,state.tiles)),first=avail[0],second=avail[1];if(first&&second){let same=alive.find(x=>x!==first&&x.type===first.type);if(same){[second.type,same.type]=[same.type,second.type]}}}state.combo=0;closeModal();render();sfx('shuffle');vibrate(35);let c=center(board.getBoundingClientRect());burst(c.x,c.y,56,8);ring(c.x,c.y,'#d8ffcc',130);alertToast('Tiles shuffled!');save()}
function undo(){if(state.busy)return;let s=state.history.pop();if(!s){alertToast('Nothing to undo');return}restoreSnapshot(s);document.querySelectorAll('.fly-tile,.arrival-echo').forEach(n=>n.remove());sfx('undo');vibrate(10)}
function magic(){if(state.busy||state.magic<=0)return;let target=state.tray[state.tray.length-1];if(!target){alertToast('Collect a tile first');return}let t=state.tiles.find(x=>x.id===target),partner=state.tiles.find(x=>x.id!==target&&x.type===t.type&&(!x.removed||state.tray.includes(x.id)));if(!partner){alertToast('No matching tile remains');return}remember();state.magic--;let slot=trayEl.children[state.tray.length-1],c=center(slot.getBoundingClientRect());burst(c.x,c.y,65,5);ring(c.x,c.y,'#ffe4aa',95);let partnerNode=board.querySelector(`[data-id="${partner.id}"]`);if(partnerNode){let cp=center(partnerNode.getBoundingClientRect());burst(cp.x,cp.y,48,4);ring(cp.x,cp.y,'#ffdd9c',60)}partner.removed=true;state.tray=state.tray.filter(x=>x!==target&&x!==partner.id);state.combo=0;state.score+=200;render();save();sfx('magic');vibrate([22,20,40]);comboText(1,200);if(!state.tiles.some(x=>!x.removed)&&state.tray.length===0)won()}
function won(){if(state.busy)return;state.busy=true;state.epoch++;state.score+=state.mode==='zen'?400:1000;const mode=state.mode;if(mode==='classic')state.level++;state.tiles=[];state.tray=[];save();$('winScore').textContent=state.score.toLocaleString('en-US');$('winTitle').textContent=mode==='daily'?'Daily Champion!':mode==='zen'?'Zen Master!':mode==='mystery'?'Mystery Solved!':'Beautiful!';$('winText').textContent='Every tile has found its match.';$('nextLevel').textContent=mode==='daily'?'PLAY CLASSIC ➜':mode==='zen'?'PLAY ZEN AGAIN ➜':mode==='mystery'?'NEW MYSTERY ➜':'NEXT LEVEL ➜';sfx('victory');let rect=app.getBoundingClientRect();for(let i=0;i<13;i++)setTimeout(()=>burst(Math.random()*rect.width+rect.left,Math.random()*rect.height*.65+rect.top,22,11),i*110);setTimeout(()=>{state.busy=false;modal('winModal')},1200)}
function comboText(combo,gained){let node=document.createElement('div');node.className='combo-text'+(combo>=3?' special':'');let title=combo===1?'NICE MATCH!':combo===2?'DOUBLE COMBO!':combo===3?'SUPER COMBO!':combo===4?'GREAT STREAK!':'SPECTACULAR!';node.innerHTML=`${title}<small>+${gained} &nbsp; ✦ &nbsp; x${combo}</small>`;$('comboLayer').appendChild(node);setTimeout(()=>node.remove(),1200)}
function updateSettings(){for(let [name,v]of [['musicToggle',state.music],['sfxToggle',state.sound],['vibrateToggle',state.vibrate]]){$(name).textContent=v?'ON':'OFF';$(name).classList.toggle('on',v)}$('themeToggle').textContent=state.theme.toUpperCase();$('ambienceSelect').value=state.ambienceMode;$('worldSelect').value=state.worldMode;$('ambienceVolume').value=state.ambienceVolume;$('ambienceValue').textContent=state.ambienceVolume+'%'}
// Animated Canvas VFX: burst particles, rings and drifting ambient fireflies.
const canvas=$('vfx'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let vw=0,vh=0,dpr=1,lastFrame=0;
function resizeVfx(){let r=app.getBoundingClientRect();vw=r.width;vh=r.height;dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.round(vw*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(vh*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
function burst(globalX,globalY,num=30,power=5){let r=app.getBoundingClientRect(),x=globalX-r.left,y=globalY-r.top,palette=(WORLDS[state.activeWorld]||WORLDS.egypt).burst;for(let i=0;i<num;i++){let angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,sp=(.6+Math.random()*.8)*power,life=28+Math.random()*36;particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(angle)*sp,vy:Math.sin(angle)*sp-1.5,gravity:.065+Math.random()*.08,life,max:life,r:1.8+Math.random()*3.2,c:palette[i%palette.length],spark:i%4===0})}if(particles.length>500)particles.splice(0,particles.length-500)}
function ring(gx,gy,color='#ffe9a0',radius=70){let r=app.getBoundingClientRect();rings.push({x:gx-r.left,y:gy-r.top,size:4,max:radius,life:26,maxlife:26,color})}
function effects(ts){let dt=Math.min((ts-lastFrame)/16.7||1,2);lastFrame=ts;ctx.clearRect(0,0,vw,vh);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=particles[i];p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vx*=.985;p.vy+=p.gravity*dt;p.life-=dt;if(p.life<=0){particles.splice(i,1);continue}ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,p.life/18);ctx.fillStyle=p.c;ctx.shadowBlur=p.spark?16:6;ctx.shadowColor=p.c;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,Math.max(.4,p.r*(p.life/p.max)),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();if(p.spark){ctx.strokeStyle=p.c;ctx.lineWidth=.9;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x-8,p.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x+8,p.y);ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y-8);ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y+8);ctx.stroke()}}for(let i=rings.length-1;i>=0;i--){let q=rings[i];q.size+=(q.max-q.size)*.18*dt;q.life-=dt;if(q.life<=0){rings.splice(i,1);continue}ctx.globalAlpha=q.life/q.maxlife*.85;ctx.strokeStyle=q.color;ctx.shadowColor=q.color;ctx.shadowBlur=14;ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,q.size,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke()}ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.shadowBlur=0;raf=requestAnimationFrame(effects)}
// Self-contained audio score and layered sound effects: plays only after user interaction.
function getAudio(){try{audio=audio||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(audio.state==='suspended')audio.resume().catch(()=>{});return audio}catch{return null}}
function note(freq,delay=0,dur=.35,vol=.045,wave='sine',attack=.012,decay=0){let a=getAudio();if(!a||!freq)return;let when=a.currentTime+Math.max(0,delay),o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=wave;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,when);if(decay)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq*decay,when+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,when);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.00015,vol),when+attack);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,when+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(when);o.stop(when+dur+.02)}
function noise(dur=.16,vol=.04,filterFreq=2400){let a=getAudio();if(!a)return;let len=Math.floor(a.sampleRate*.45),data=a.createBuffer(1,len,a.sampleRate),ch=data.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<len;i++)ch[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/len,2);let b=a.createBufferSource(),f=a.createBiquadFilter(),g=a.createGain();b.buffer=data;f.type='highpass';f.frequency.value=filterFreq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,a.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,a.currentTime+dur);b.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);b.start();b.stop(a.currentTime+dur+.02)}
function sfx(kind){if(!state.sound)return;let a=getAudio();if(!a)return;if(kind==='collect'){note(510,0,.13,.075,'triangle',.004,1.45);note(790,.06,.2,.045,'sine');noise(.11,.014,3400)}else if(kind==='match'||kind==='combo'){let notes=kind==='combo'?[587,784,988,1175,1568]:[523,659,784,1046];notes.forEach((f,i)=>{note(f,i*.072,.36,.065,'sine',.009);note(f/2,i*.072,.22,.022,'triangle')});noise(.24,.045,3200);note(160,0,.38,.055,'triangle',.008,.55)}else if(kind==='hint'){[784,988,1175].forEach((f,i)=>note(f,i*.08,.36,.04,'sine'))}else if(kind==='shuffle'){[260,340,425,560,730].forEach((f,i)=>note(f,i*.065,.3,.04,'triangle'));noise(.36,.027,800)}else if(kind==='magic'){[262,392,523,784,1046,1568].forEach((f,i)=>note(f,i*.065,.52,.063,'sine'));noise(.42,.06,3000)}else if(kind==='victory'){[392,523,659,784,988,1175,1568,1976].forEach((f,i)=>{note(f,i*.115,.7,.055,'sine');note(f/2,i*.115,.54,.023,'triangle')});noise(.38,.04,2500)}else if(kind==='error'){note(180,0,.19,.045,'triangle',.01,.7)}else if(kind==='undo'||kind==='return'){note(580,0,.17,.035,'sine',.008,.7);note(390,.08,.16,.03,'sine')}}

const AMBIENT_AUDIO={"rain":"
